text_block_list.text:
I brought an injured Winning Ticket
to the nurse's office...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh~...
I kinda messed up a little bit...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But still, but still, an injury like this is no big deal!
I got it patched up properly, so—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
My full-throttle power will heal it up in no time!
Let's get back to training, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Let's play it safe and take the day off.
Alright, let's give it our all!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
My full-throttle power will heal it up in no time!
Let's get back to training, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Let's play it safe and take the day off.
Alright, let's give it our all!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it really doesn't bother me at all~!
When you're active, getting banged up here and there is totally normal!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
—Kh!!
F-For you to worry about me that much......!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so happy~!!
I'm so haaappy~!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer!
Today, just like you said—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Get plenty of rest and heal up completely!
Then starting tomorrow, let's give it our all in training again!

"That day, Winning Ticket cut her training short
and got plenty of rest."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm, that's my Trainer! That's the spirit!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: All riiiight! Full-speed dash all the way to the training course, whooosh—
(—Throb!!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: —Gwahhh!!??

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh!!
O-Of course...! I'm totally fine—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...No, it's not!!
It actually! Really! Throbs a tonnn!!

"...I wrapped up training early
and let Winning Ticket get some rest."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: All riiiight! Full-speed dash all the way to the training course, whooosh!
choice_data_list: Still, overdoing it is strictly forbidden!
Still, overdoing it is strictly forbidden!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Thanks for worrying about me!
If it starts throbbing, I'll tell you right away!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
My full-throttle power
won't lose to something like an injury...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'll show you what I've got in training!
Concerned about Winning Ticket's injury, I had her rest before resuming her training.
